results.title: Dreamboi
results.overview: A trans woman becomes entranced by the voice of an underground audio porn star. Torn between fantasy and reality, she drifts through the neon haze of Quezon City on a journey of desire, pain, and self-discovery.

results.title: Uncle Roy
results.overview: A documentary portrait of Roy Blakey, a pioneering figure skater, collector, and photographer who became known for his influential male nude photography in New York’s art world. Through archival footage, photographs, and intimate present-day moments, filmmaker Keri Pickett reflects on her lifelong bond with the uncle who mentored and inspired her. As 93-year-old Roy faces life-threatening dementia and his memories begin to fade, she races to preserve his legacy — a figure skater, ice-show archivist, and gay photographer whose male nudes etched into history. Tracing Roy’s journey from Depression-era beginnings and international ice shows to his role documenting queer culture, the film becomes a tribute to an unconventional artist and a moving exploration of family, memory, and legacy before his final curtain call.

results.title: Runners
results.overview: Ben is sent on a delivery job for his father, when his brother Harry unexpectedly joins him. As suspicion grows and tension rises, only one question comes to mind: what’s in the boot?

results.title: One Shot of Espresso
results.overview: A psychological thriller about an interaction between a cafe owner and a customer that takes a dark turn.

results.title: One of the Good Ones
results.overview: In a system corrupted by politics, greed and sex, there's an honest man in Buffalo who's made it his life's mission to hold his peers accountable. Dean Alessi is an attorney in Buffalo's Lawyer Disciplinary Office who fights for justice, even as he battles his own personal demons. Dean took an oath to protect the public from bad lawyers, and is willing to risk everything to keep that sacred promise. As the bodies pile up, Dean puts his own life on the line when he disobeys orders to expose a corrupt District Attorney who has committed the ultimate ethical wrong - murder.

results.title: Idda
results.overview: Adele and Sofia, childhood friends now in their thirties, reunite after years apart to fulfill a dream they once shared: reaching the summit of Mount Etna. But something feels off, and a bitter confrontation breaks out, opening old wounds and unveiling deeply buried secrets. They separate just as the volcano begins to tremble. Adele presses on alone, haunted by the wish that she had turned back and reached the crater together with Sofia to listen to the mountain’s magical breathing.

results.title: The Roots
results.overview: After a decade in Canada, a Bangladeshi immigrant Akash returns to Bangladesh with his child, seeking to reconnect with his abandoned family and past. But time has reshaped everything—relationships have faded, and home feels distant. Struggling with identity and belonging, he confronts the silent weight of migration and the ache of return. Feature Film ‘The Roots’ is a poignant exploration of identity, nostalgia, loss, and the search for home across two worlds.

results.title: The Second Life of Freddie Nole
results.original_title: The Second Life of Freddie Nole
results.overview: When Freddie Nole drives to meet a man walking out of prison, he’s not just offering a ride, he’s offering hope, dignity, and a path to permanent freedom. As this vérité road trip unfolds, we come to learn the remarkable story behind Freddie’s mission, a staggering mistake that cost him 50 years of freedom but ultimately brings him right back to the prison door.

results.title: Clownspiracy
results.overview: A small town high school misfit investigates the appearance of creepy clowns before an upcoming election, discovering the clowns are more than they appear.

results.title: Salam Shalom - The Untold Story of a Jewish Family in Pakistan
results.original_title: Salam Shalom - The Untold Story of a Jewish Family in Pakistan
results.overview: Salam Shalom follows Hazel Selzer Kahan, born in the predominantly Muslim city of Lahore to Jewish physicians who fled Nazi Germany. Now 86 and living in the U.S., Hazel revisits her hometown to preserve a legacy of refuge, survival, and cross-cultural kinship while confronting the complex layers of her identity.

results.title: Жемчужная моя
results.overview: The story of Alina Chistyakova, founder of a brand of pearl crowns and necklaces crafted using the ancient technique of pearl planting. Alina travels to the village where she spent her childhood to show off her pearl necklaces to her fellow villagers—tractor drivers resting after work, women gathered at a food truck. After all, their great-grandmothers made such necklaces, and not long ago, their grandmothers wore them when they got married… Will the sight of beauty awaken the people's memory? And what will this village comedy of two worlds colliding lead to?

results.title: Finding Harmony: A King's Vision
results.overview: In an unprecedented portrait of King Charles III, Finding Harmony: A King's Vision provides intimate insight into His Majesty's passionate quest to reunite humanity with nature. Academy Award-winner Kate Winslet narrates this journey through The King's Foundation's vital work.

results.title: Mbappé, la diplomatie du ballon rond
results.original_title: Mbappé, la diplomatie du ballon rond

results.title: Roll No. 1
results.overview: A story of a boy struggling to fulfill his father's dream of winning a scholarship from the government.

results.title: Hard as Puck
results.overview: A motley crew of para ice hockey skaters fight to keep their grassroots sporting club on the rink in this stirring, often hilarious documentary.

results.title: House Cat
results.overview: Living out of her car and hustling gig to gig, a woman takes a last-ditch job house-sitting a cat, only to discover she isn’t there to care for the cat; she is the cat.

results.title: Give Me Back My Body!
results.overview: Jack, a quadriplegic, and Lina, his day nurse, spy on neighbors with a drone and stumble upon a serial killer. When Lina finds a mysterious relic inside the killer's house, it transports her and Jack to an underworld where they switch bodies and are forced to kill for a creature. Embracing the killing inside Lina's body, will Jack want to switch back?

results.title: Fòs - Chronicle of Guadeloupean Fencing
results.overview: Narrated by Olympic champion Enzo Lefort, this documentary traces the legacy of Guadeloupean fencing.  From Mayolè, the combat art of slaves in the 16th century, to current Olympic dominance.  How did this small Caribbean island produce more than a third of French fencing medals over twenty years?
